title: Vivatech Paris
metaDescription: Vivatech Paris: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tech Events.

overview.about: VivaTech is Europe's biggest startup and technology event, held each June in Paris. It brings together founders, global corporations, investors and heads of state for a high-profile programme on AI, deep tech and the future of innovation.
overview.nextEvent: The next VivaTech is held in June at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. The programme mixes marquee keynotes with a vast exhibition of startups and corporate innovation labs, plus one of Europe's largest tech recruitment fairs.
